title: Proklepni to
tagline: Co vás trápí na pravidlech z EU?
description: Czech-language tool where people write or say what annoys them about EU or Czech rules, such as cars, boilers or fuel prices. It sorts what is true from myth, says who decided it, and helps users write to their MEP. It states it is not an official EU or government site.

title: EUROPARUN
tagline: Jump across Europe in a pixel-art runner
description: A mobile-friendly pixel-art endless runner where players jump across European cities and collect postcards. It has a public hackathon leaderboard that shows only a generated nickname, with no name, email or location collected.

title: Keep your competence while using AI
tagline: Learn with AI, think for yourself.
description: A project for lower secondary (ages 11-15) and upper secondary school students (15-19). We educate the whole school community in the proper use of artificial intelligence while developing and protecting students’ cognitive and creative skills.

title: SMR are the HORIZON
tagline: Cheaper energy, local jobs, Czechia leading on SMRs
description: A tool for SMR advocates to get informed and involved, available in Czech, English and Polish. It explains small modular reactors through interactive charts on emissions, household savings, regional jobs and local business, with a world map of projects and a 3D reactor guide. The figures are model scenarios, and the site says savings are not guaranteed.

title: Taven Saste Platform
tagline: Inclusive crisis management for Roma communities
description: A crisis and rights hub for Romani families in the Czech Republic, available in English, Czech and Romani. Users pick a phase (before, during or after a crisis) to get prioritised safety checklists, a plan based on their legal rights, free aid kits and nearby community matching for help. The site states that some contacts are placeholders awaiting verified local partner data.

title: mesheink
tagline: A solar-powered mesh node you can build at home
description: An open-hardware LoRa node running Meshtastic with an E-Ink screen, designed for off-grid messaging without internet or a mobile network. The site covers hardware, build and solar guides, accessibility add-ons such as a Braille keyboard, and in-browser verification of signed firmware releases. It states it is an unofficial community project, not affiliated with Meshtastic.

title: TANDER
description: TANDER helps project teams make transdisciplinary collaboration easier and more impactful: it spots missing perspectives, suggests experts from other disciplines and shows how different actors can contribute to a shared challenge. Its T-INDEX assesses the depth of collaboration, how decision-making power is distributed and whether affected people are involved, helping teams build more inclusive projects and show their value to funders. The site is a demo with fictional people and data.
